top_story.title: Is Bitcoin a Good Long-Term Investment for Beginners?
top_story.summary: At around $77,000 in May 2026, Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) is off its October 2025 peak of $126,000, and anyone weighing it as a long-term investment is looking at an asset with an extraordinary track record—and a history of stomach-churning crashes along the way. Like any other asset, Bitcoin goes through downturns. What stands out is ... Is Bitcoin a Good Long-Term Investment for Beginners?
